name: LiteLLM Proxy
description: Unified proxy server exposing an OpenAI-compatible API in front of over 100 language model providers.

envVars.description: Master key clients must present to call the proxy
Salt key used to encrypt stored provider credentials
Password for the LiteLLM Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://litellm:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/litellm"
      LITELLM_MASTER_KEY: {{env.LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}}
      LITELLM_SALT_KEY: {{env.LITELLM_SALT_KEY}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/app/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: litellm
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: litellm
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
